sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Liberia Immigration Service route depends on embassy availability in the traveller's country and does not establish a Portuguese-passport-only baseline.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa service
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's live state page describes electronic delivery but publishes no Portuguese ordinary-passport eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Interior Ministry portal asks applicants to determine eligibility but provides no Portuguese ordinary-passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.

sources.title: Sierra Leone eVisa service
sources.publisher: Sierra Leone Immigration Department eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: Sierra Leone Immigration Department's live slid.gov.sl page links www.evisa.sl as its 'Official Portal.' That live service contains airport/border issuance wording and does not independently establish a Portuguese route or a single issuance point.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.
